coverage: Mutual development of science and technology
Chemical synthesis and large-scale chemical production
Geology, meteorology, oceanography and other sciences

adaptation.from: 目前…大约四分之一世纪以前开始的最伟大的科学技术革命
adaptation.to: Continuing reciprocal scientific and technological development
adaptation.reason: The relative quarter-century date belongs to the old textbook, not the present reader; the superlative is not a scientific measurement. Preserve the cross-field transformation, not an invented modern start date.

adaptation.from: 人进入宇宙空间
adaptation.to: Space technology permits observation outside the atmosphere
adaptation.reason: Do not imply that all astronomical progress depends on human spaceflight rather than space-based instruments.

adaptation.from: 大化学
adaptation.to: Chemical synthesis and industrial chemical production
adaptation.reason: Explain the obsolete industrial term in ordinary modern language.

zh.text:
科学研究和技术创新相互促进，能够使许多领域的研究方法和生产方式发生深刻变化。
天文学是一门古老的科学，航天技术使人们能够从地球大气层之外观测宇宙。

分子生物学和遗传学推动了对生命过程的研究，化学的发展扩大了化学工业合成和生产物质的能力。
地质学、气象学、海洋学及其他自然科学也因新的理论、仪器和方法而不断发展。

en.text:
Scientific research and technological innovation support one another and can profoundly change methods of investigation and production.
Astronomy is an ancient science, and space technology makes it possible to observe the universe from beyond Earth's atmosphere.

Molecular biology and genetics have advanced the study of life processes, while progress in chemistry has expanded the chemical industry's ability to synthesize and produce substances.
Geology, meteorology, oceanography and other natural sciences also develop through new theories, instruments and methods.

coverage: Mechanization and automation in industry and agriculture

adaptation.from: 所有的主要技术部门…由热电站转到原子能发电站
adaptation.to: Developments across the named sectors; nuclear generation is an additional pathway
adaptation.reason: Replace a universal energy-transition prediction with a qualified explanation, retaining the named sectors.

adaptation.from: 不可避免的革命／从根本上变成…完善得多
adaptation.to: Changes in many processes and means of improving performance
adaptation.reason: Technical potential is not a guarantee of universal progress.

zh.text:
能源、材料、生产和基础设施的技术都在发展。
发电技术的发展包括在燃烧化石燃料之外利用核能，但不能把它说成所有火电站都必然转为核电站。

材料科学使人们能够制造具有特定实用性质的材料，机械化和自动化改变了工业与农业的许多生产过程。
运输、建筑和通信也因技术改进而获得了提高效率和性能的手段。

en.text:
Technologies for energy, materials, production and infrastructure continue to develop.
Changes in electricity generation include using nuclear energy alongside the combustion of fossil fuels, rather than an inevitable conversion of every fossil-fuel power station to a nuclear plant.

Materials science enables the manufacture of materials with particular useful properties, and mechanization and automation have changed many industrial and agricultural processes.
Technological improvements also provide ways to improve the efficiency and performance of transport, construction and communication.

coverage: Inventions and achievements improve material production

adaptation.from: 科学变为直接的生产力／命运将直接取决于科学
adaptation.to: Knowledge becomes productive through application, subject to practical conditions
adaptation.reason: Retain the science-to-production relationship without presenting a social slogan or a single-factor deterministic claim as a physical law.

zh.text:
科学的发展增强了它对社会生活和生产的影响。
科学知识通过发明、工程设计和实际应用，能够转化为生产能力。
人们所需的物质产品的生产因科学成果而得到改进，但成果能否发挥作用还取决于组织、资源和应用条件。

en.text:
Scientific development has increased science's influence on social life and production.
Through inventions, engineering design and practical application, scientific knowledge can become a productive capability.
Scientific achievements can improve the production of material goods that people need, but their practical effects also depend on organization, resources and the conditions of use.

coverage: Material and technical capacity serves social needs

adaptation.from: 不可避免地…全部范畴／社会主义世界…共产主义的物质技术基础
adaptation.to: Practical capacity to improve production and meet needs, with socially contingent outcomes
adaptation.reason: Explicitly replace political inevitability and propaganda with a neutral account at the same entry position; preserve the production-and-social-needs instructional connection.

zh.text:
科学技术的进步能够推动生产方式的大规模改进。
把知识转化为可靠的设备、工艺和基础设施，有助于满足社会的物质需要。
这些改进的社会效果取决于人们怎样组织和使用技术，并不由某种政治制度或技术发展本身自动保证。

en.text:
Scientific and technological progress can support large-scale improvements in production.
Turning knowledge into reliable equipment, processes and infrastructure can help meet society's material needs.

The social effects of these improvements depend on how people organize and use technology;
they are not automatically guaranteed by a political system or by technological development itself.

coverage: Physics is a major foundational natural science
Connections with research, technology and production

adaptation.from: 魁首之一／下面分析几例
adaptation.to: Important foundation and a concrete introduction to the following examples
adaptation.reason: Keep the instructional transition without ranking sciences or adding a new example.

zh.text:
物理学是现代自然科学的重要基础之一。
它研究的规律和发展出的仪器，对科学研究、技术和生产的许多领域都有重要影响。
天文学、生命科学、能源和电子技术中的例子，可以说明这种联系。

en.text:
Physics is an important foundation of modern natural science.
The laws it investigates and the instruments it develops influence many fields of research, technology and production.
Examples from astronomy, the life sciences, energy and electronics illustrate these connections.

coverage: Long history of mainly visible-light astronomy
Narrow visible band within broad electromagnetic spectrum
Radio astronomy and new celestial information
Neutrinos and stellar interiors, including solar core
Nuclear and particle physics underpin neutrino detection
Source's antimatter-world question addressed rather than dropped

adaptation.from: 二十年以前
adaptation.to: Advances in radio physics enabled radio astronomy
adaptation.reason: Remove the obsolete source-relative twenty-year date, preserving the causal development without inventing a modern date.

adaptation.from: 几千年…仅仅是可见光
adaptation.to: Thousands of years of observations mainly using visible light
adaptation.reason: Retain the historical scale while avoiding an absolute exclusion of other astronomical information.

adaptation.from: 现在又建立了中微子天文学基础／将带来太阳深处的信息
adaptation.to: Neutrino observations investigate nuclear reactions in the solar core
adaptation.reason: Replace an old future promise with an established scientific explanation; neutrino flavour change is a necessary modern interpretive qualification, not an added exercise.

adaptation.from: 就是它帮助我们解决了…反世界…存在的问题
adaptation.to: Neutrino astronomy has not settled macroscopic antimatter-world existence; matter-antimatter asymmetry remains a research subject
adaptation.reason: Do not repeat a scientifically unsupported resolution claim or silently omit the source's topic.

zh.text:
数千年来，天文学的观测主要依靠可见光，而可见光只占电磁波谱的一小部分。
无线电物理学的发展使射电天文学成为新的观测途径，扩大了人们对宇宙的认识。
不同无线电波段的观测能够补充可见光观测，帮助研究过去难以发现或了解的天体。

电磁辐射之外，中微子也是天文信息的载体。
中微子能从恒星内部带出信息，太阳中微子的观测就能帮助研究太阳核心的核反应。
这种观测还必须考虑中微子在传播中改变种类的现象。

核物理学和粒子物理学为中微子探测提供了理论和实验基础。
但是，中微子天文学并没有解决宇宙中是否存在由反粒子组成的宏观世界的问题，宇宙中物质与反物质的不对称仍需研究。

en.text:
For thousands of years, astronomical observations relied mainly on visible light, which occupies only a small part of the electromagnetic spectrum.
Advances in radio physics made radio astronomy another means of observation and broadened our understanding of the universe.

Observations in different radio bands complement visible-light observations and help investigate celestial objects that were previously difficult to detect or understand.
Neutrinos provide a carrier of astronomical information in addition to electromagnetic radiation.

Neutrinos can carry information from stellar interiors, and observations of solar neutrinos help investigate nuclear reactions in the Sun's core.
Their interpretation must also account for neutrinos changing type as they travel.

Nuclear and particle physics provide the theoretical and experimental foundations for neutrino detection.
Neutrino astronomy has not settled whether macroscopic worlds made of antiparticles exist, and the universe's matter-antimatter asymmetry remains a subject of research.

coverage: Atmospheric absorption and access from space
Ultraviolet, infrared, X and gamma astronomy
Primary cosmic rays before atmospheric interaction

adaptation.from: 其他形式…被大气吸收而没有传到地球
adaptation.to: Many bands are absorbed; some atmospheric windows remain
adaptation.reason: Avoid an absolute transmission claim, including the false implication that all infrared radiation is inaccessible from the ground.

adaptation.from: 所有类型的粒子和射线／最近几十年信息量超过整个历史
adaptation.to: Different instruments expand information substantially, without exhaustive detection or an unmeasured historical information total
adaptation.reason: Preserve the expanding observational reach, not universal or undefined quantitative claims.

adaptation.from: [HOLD:p0394-r07-punctuation]
adaptation.to: New complete modern sentences
adaptation.reason: Modern punctuation is independently authored, not an archival comma/semicolon determination; the marker remains exact in source_text and source.data.

zh.text:
地球大气会吸收来自宇宙的许多波段的电磁辐射，因此地面观测只能利用某些能够穿过大气的波段。
把仪器送到大气层之外，可以获得地面难以接收到的信息。
空间观测扩展了紫外线、红外线、$x$ 射线和 $\gamma$ 射线天文学，也使人们能够研究尚未与大气相互作用的初级宇宙射线。

不同仪器探测不同波段和粒子，不能把这说成已经能够观测所有类型的粒子和辐射。
这些观测显著增加了天文学的信息来源，物理学提供的探测方法和记录仪器发挥了重要作用。
天文学与物理学的结合，使天体物理学能够更深入地研究天体的性质和过程。

en.text:
Earth's atmosphere absorbs electromagnetic radiation from many parts of the spectrum, so ground-based observations use particular bands that can pass through it.
Sending instruments beyond the atmosphere provides information that is difficult to receive at the surface.

Space observations extend ultraviolet, infrared, $x$ ray and $\gamma$ ray astronomy and allow the study of primary cosmic rays before they interact with the atmosphere.
Different instruments detect different bands and particles.

This does not mean that every kind of particle and radiation can already be observed.
These observations have greatly expanded astronomy's sources of information, with an important contribution from detection methods and recording instruments developed in physics.
Combining astronomy with physics allows astrophysics to investigate the properties and processes of celestial objects more deeply.

coverage: Molecular basis of life rather than living molecules
Electron and source proton/charged-particle method category

adaptation.from: 活的极其小的粒子——分子上的生命
adaptation.to: Molecular basis of life processes; molecules are not independently alive
adaptation.reason: Correct the ontology while retaining the microscopic subject matter.

adaptation.from: 电子和质子显微镜／x射线组织分析／电子照像
adaptation.to: Electron microscopy and charged-particle-beam methods; X-ray structural analysis; electron imaging
adaptation.reason: Retain the particle-beam method category without presenting proton microscopy as a standard molecular-biology microscope or guessing that the faithful source should have said electron. Clarify structural analysis rather than tissue terminology. This is modern scientific wording, not a source transcription or formula repair.

adaptation.from: 所有方法都是物理学应用／没有它们就不能质变
adaptation.to: Explain several physical principles and the joint contributions of physics, biology and chemistry
adaptation.reason: Preserve the role and complete named method categories without exclusive-cause rhetoric.

zh.text:
分子生物学和遗传学研究生命过程的分子基础以及遗传信息的传递和作用。
分子是构成生命系统的物质成分，并不是独立生活的微小生命体。
研究人员利用电子显微镜和带电粒子束方法、$x$ 射线结构分析、电子成像、中子分析、同位素示踪及超速离心等方法，观察、分离或研究生物样品。

这里的不同方法各有适用范围，不能把它们都当作同一种显微成像技术。
这些方法分别利用粒子或射线与物质的相互作用、放射性或旋转运动等物理规律。
物理学提供的理论、仪器和实验方法，与生物学和化学的研究共同推动了对生命过程的深入认识。

en.text:
Molecular biology and genetics investigate the molecular basis of life processes and the transmission and action of genetic information.
Molecules are material components of living systems, not tiny organisms that live independently.

Researchers use electron microscopy and charged-particle-beam methods, $x$ ray structural analysis, electron imaging, neutron analysis, isotope tracing and ultracentrifugation to observe, separate or investigate biological samples.
These methods have different domains of use and are not all the same kind of microscopic imaging.

They use physical principles such as interactions of particles or radiation with matter, radioactivity and rotational motion.
Theories, instruments and experimental methods from physics work together with biological and chemical research to deepen our understanding of life processes.

coverage: Physics contributes to geology and oceanography

adaptation.from: 革命改造…不亚于以上方面
adaptation.to: Contribution of physical theories and methods to the named sciences
adaptation.reason: Preserve the cross-disciplinary conclusion without an unsupported comparative ranking.

zh.text:
物理学的理论和实验方法也帮助化学、地质学、海洋学及其他自然科学研究物质的性质和自然过程。
这些学科的发展体现了不同科学之间的相互支持。

en.text:
Theories and experimental methods from physics also help chemistry, geology, oceanography and other natural sciences investigate the properties of matter and natural processes.
Their development illustrates how different sciences support one another.

adaptation.from: 所有技术领域革命改造的起源
adaptation.to: A scientific foundation for many developments alongside other disciplines
adaptation.reason: Avoid attributing every technological development exclusively to physics while retaining every listed sector.

zh.text:
物理学也是许多技术发展的科学基础。
能源工程、通信、运输、建筑及工农业生产，都能够利用物理规律和物理研究成果改进设备与工艺。
这些改进还需要其他学科和工程实践的共同作用。

en.text:
Physics also provides a scientific foundation for many technological developments.
Energy engineering, communication, transport, construction and industrial and agricultural production can use physical laws and research findings to improve equipment and processes.
Such improvements also require contributions from other disciplines and engineering practice.

coverage: Exact source million-scale energy comparison retained with equal-mass reaction basis
Potential nuclear fuel energy and resource availability
Coal, oil and gas as fuel and chemical feedstocks

adaptation.from: 电站从燃料获取…几百万倍
adaptation.to: Several million times on an equal-mass, complete-fission-versus-coal-combustion energy basis
adaptation.reason: D378 confirmed the source multiplier 几百万倍. Preserve that scale and explicitly correct the comparison basis; do not substitute 几百倍 or invent a source erratum. No new numerical example or equation.

adaptation.from: 核燃料能量储藏量必然大得多
adaptation.to: Potential depends on accessible materials, fuel cycles and technology
adaptation.reason: Distinguish physical energy potential from recoverable resources and actual generation.

adaptation.from: 煤、石油和天然气…仅存的原料
adaptation.to: Both fuel and chemical feedstock roles; combustion consumes finite resources
adaptation.reason: Retain the conservation argument without falsely denying their fuel use or implying that the chemical industry has no other feedstocks.

adaptation.from: 铀钍没有任何重要工业采用／不会带来损失
adaptation.to: Fuel uses and potential with safety, waste and resource constraints
adaptation.reason: Replace historical universal assertions and a no-cost implication, preserving the source's two materials and their energy significance.

zh.text:
核能利用为能源工程提供了不同于燃烧化学燃料的途径。
按相同质量的可裂变物质发生完全裂变与煤燃烧所释放的能量比较，前者可达到后者的几百万倍，这不是两座电站实际发电量或效率的倍数。
核燃料资源的潜在能量取决于可利用的材料、燃料循环和技术条件，不能只凭地下储量就断言实际可用能量必然大于化石燃料。

煤、石油和天然气既可作燃料，也可作化学工业原料，大量燃烧它们会消耗这些有限资源。
铀可用于核燃料，钍在适当的核燃料循环中也具有利用潜力，但不能说使用它们不会产生任何资源或环境代价。
核能的高能量密度是其重要特点，实际利用还需要考虑安全、放射性废物和资源管理。

en.text:
Nuclear energy gives energy engineering a pathway distinct from burning chemical fuels.
For equal masses, complete fission of fissile material can release several million times as much energy as burning coal.

This is not a ratio of the actual electricity output or efficiency of two power stations.
The potential energy of nuclear-fuel resources depends on usable materials, fuel cycles and technological conditions.

Underground reserves alone do not establish that practically available nuclear energy must exceed the energy available from fossil fuels.
Coal, oil and natural gas serve both as fuels and as raw materials for the chemical industry, and burning large quantities consumes these finite resources.

Uranium can be used as nuclear fuel, and thorium also has potential in suitable nuclear fuel cycles, but their use is not free of resource or environmental costs.
High energy density is an important characteristic of nuclear energy.
Its practical use must also consider safety, radioactive waste and resource management.

coverage: Nuclear physics underpins fission and fusion

adaptation.from: 热核发电站…将永远…从能源担心中解放
adaptation.to: Fusion potential with physical and engineering requirements
adaptation.reason: Replace an unconditional prediction with a scientifically sound account; no latest deployment or commercial date is asserted.

adaptation.from: 科学基础完全依赖核物理
adaptation.to: Nuclear physics foundation plus other physics and engineering
adaptation.reason: Retain the nuclear foundation without excluding plasma, materials and engineering contributions.

zh.text:
可控核聚变有提供能源的潜力，但不能保证人类永远不再面临能源问题。
把聚变反应变成可靠的发电技术，还需要解决反应维持、能量利用、材料和工程等问题。
核裂变和核聚变能源的科学基础都与核物理学密切相关，实际发电系统还需要其他物理学领域和工程技术的支持。

en.text:
Controlled nuclear fusion has the potential to supply energy, but it cannot guarantee that humanity will never face energy problems again.
Turning fusion reactions into reliable electricity generation requires solutions for sustaining the reaction, using its energy, materials and engineering.

Nuclear physics provides a scientific foundation for both fission and fusion energy.
Practical power systems also need support from other fields of physics and engineering.

coverage: Materials designed for prescribed useful properties
Strong fields, pressure, temperature and ultrasound

adaptation.from: 未来技术将不用现成自然物质／可靠永久
adaptation.to: Designed properties with continuing material-feedstock requirements
adaptation.reason: Replace a universal future claim while preserving the engineered-materials emphasis and the entire source list of physical method categories.

adaptation.from: 超强／超高条件…根本改变工艺
adaptation.to: Strong fields and high pressure/temperature applied where suitable
adaptation.reason: Do not imply that arbitrarily extreme treatment guarantees useful properties or universal manufacturing transformation.

zh.text:
**现代技术能够利用为特定用途设计性质的材料**，但这些材料仍需要物质原料，并不意味着不再使用自然资源。
材料合成和加工使人们能够调节材料的性质，以适应技术的需要。

电子束、离子束、激光束、强磁场、高压、高温和超声等物理方法，可以与化学方法结合，用于适当材料的制备或处理。
这些方法能够产生特定的材料性质和新的加工方式，从而改进生产工艺。

en.text:
**Modern technology can use materials whose properties are designed for particular purposes**, but these materials still require material feedstocks and do not eliminate the use of natural resources.
Material synthesis and processing allow properties to be adjusted to technological needs.

Physical methods using electron beams, ion beams, laser beams, strong magnetic fields, high pressure, high temperature and ultrasound can be combined with chemical methods to prepare or treat suitable materials.
They can produce particular material properties and new ways of processing materials, thereby improving production processes.

coverage: Radio electronics, solid-state physics and relevant nuclear methods

adaptation.from: 工农业越来越转变为综合自动化／不可思议／有机联系
adaptation.to: Many processes use measurement, monitoring and electronic control, with particular physical foundations
adaptation.reason: Retain the automation mechanism and disciplines without asserting that every sector or every instrument depends on nuclear physics.

zh.text:
工业和农业中的许多生产过程可以采用自动化。
自动化系统需要测量生产状态，并通过电子控制装置调节设备的运行。

各种测量、监测和控制仪器，为这种运行提供信息和手段。
它们的设计与无线电电子学、固体物理学及其他物理学领域有关，某些测量方法还利用核物理学的成果。

en.text:
Many production processes in industry and agriculture can be automated.
Automated systems measure the state of a process and use electronic controls to adjust equipment operation.

Measuring, monitoring and control instruments provide the information and means needed for this operation.
Their design draws on radio electronics, solid-state physics and other fields of physics, while some measurement methods also use results from nuclear physics.

coverage: Three early device generations in source order
Vacuum tubes, transistors and integrated circuits
Laser and holography potential for computing

adaptation.from: 至今我们制造的三代／都是物理实验室诞生
adaptation.to: Three early generations classified by principal device, with physics as a foundation
adaptation.reason: Retain the source's three-generation sequence without an obsolete terminal date or an exclusive invention-location claim.

adaptation.from: 激光全息照像…巨大潜力
adaptation.to: Laser and holographic optical-information methods offer research pathways
adaptation.reason: Explain the source's potential as a physical approach, not guaranteed replacement or a newly invented deployed computer.

adaptation.from: [HOLD:p0396-r10-punctuation]
adaptation.to: New modern sentence listing size, speed and reliability
adaptation.reason: New punctuation does not resolve the faithful scan's punctuation qualification; source marker remains untouched.

zh.text:
物理学为电子计算技术提供了重要基础。
早期电子计算机通常按主要器件分为真空管、晶体管和集成电路①三代，这种历史分类并不表示计算机的发展到此为止。

对器件和材料的物理研究，有助于缩小电路尺寸、提高运算速度和可靠性。
激光技术以及利用相干光记录和重建光信息的全息技术，也为光信息处理和相关计算技术的研究提供了途径，但不能据此断言它们会普遍替代电子电路。

en.text:
Physics provides an important foundation for electronic computing.
Early electronic computers are commonly grouped into three generations according to their main devices: vacuum tubes, transistors and integrated circuits①.

This historical classification does not mean that computer development ended there.
Physical research on devices and materials helps reduce circuit size and improve computational speed and reliability.

Laser technology and holographic techniques, which use coherent light to record and reconstruct optical information, also provide approaches for research in optical information processing and related computing technologies.
This does not establish that they will generally replace electronic circuits.

coverage: Integrated rather than externally wired discrete elements
Internal semiconductor modification and surface films
Match-head miniaturization example with circuit-versus-complete-radio distinction

adaptation.from: 渗入半导体晶体内／沉积表面…分子薄层
adaptation.to: Impurity atoms modify semiconductor regions; deposited and patterned films form devices
adaptation.reason: D378 confirms faithful 渗入, which remains exact. Modern semiconductor explanation is an explicitly authorized scientific adaptation, not a change to the source character, an inferred source erratum or a new formula.

adaptation.from: 火柴头大小的收音机
adaptation.to: Match-head-sized chip containing part of a radio circuit, not all external components
adaptation.reason: Preserve the original scale illustration while distinguishing an integrated circuit from an entire working radio; do not invent a named product or specifications.

zh.text:
① 集成电路把许多电子元件及其连接制作在很小的芯片上，而不是把一组独立元件用外部导线逐一连接起来。
制造时可以通过向半导体中引入杂质原子来改变局部性质，也可以在表面形成并加工薄膜。

这些步骤形成有特定结构和电学功能的器件，不能简单地把它们理解为某种分子薄层。
小型化可以使收音机的部分电路集中到火柴头大小的芯片上，但芯片并不等于包含天线、电源和其他部件的完整收音机。

en.text:
① An integrated circuit forms many electronic components and their connections on a small chip, instead of linking a collection of separate components one by one with external wires.
Manufacturing can change local semiconductor properties by introducing impurity atoms and can also form and pattern thin films on the surface.

These steps produce devices with particular structures and electrical functions.
They cannot simply be described as layers of a particular kind of molecule.
Miniaturization can put part of a radio's circuitry on a chip the size of a match head, but the chip is not a complete radio with its antenna, power supply and other components.

coverage: Preserved emphasis with neutral substantive wording

adaptation.from: 足够使人确信／决定性的贡献
adaptation.to: Examples show important contributions and cross-disciplinary cooperation
adaptation.reason: Retain the synthesis without treating a superlative or exact archival emphasis range as a newly certified scientific fact.

zh.text:
这些例子没有涵盖物理学对科学和技术的全部影响，但已经说明了它与许多领域的密切联系。**
现代物理学对科学技术的发展作出了重要贡献**，这些贡献与其他学科和工程实践相互配合。

en.text: These examples do not cover every influence of physics on science and technology, but they show its close connections with many fields. **Modern physics has made important contributions to scientific and technological development**, working together with other disciplines and engineering practice.

coverage: Importance of basic natural laws and physics knowledge

adaptation.from: 只有…共产主义各尽所能按需分配才能实现
adaptation.to: Physical knowledge supports practical capacity; social distribution is not a conclusion of physics
adaptation.reason: Explicitly replace ideological inevitability while preserving the connection between knowledge, technical development, production and needs.

zh.text:
认识自然界的基本规律，特别是学习物理学，有助于人们理解技术并继续发展科学和工程。
把这些知识用于实际问题，能够为改善生产和满足人的需要提供手段。
技术能力本身并不能决定社会怎样分配产品，也不能保证某种社会理想必然实现。

en.text:
Understanding the basic laws of nature, especially through physics, helps people understand technology and continue developing science and engineering.
Applying this knowledge to practical problems provides means to improve production and meet human needs.
Technological capability by itself does not determine how society distributes goods or guarantee the realization of a particular social ideal.
